fix: Use local GitHub CLI credential discovery and curl-based binary transfer so API outages are not misreported as missing authentication and gh 2.87.2 cannot corrupt the staging ZIP download.
icon: 4096px pearl-white macOS tile with bold 3D champagne-gold Mando rings and a centered dimensional Chrome core, plus a generated macOS ICNS icon set.
network_retry: Retry transient GitHub download failures four times before preserving the existing extension and reporting failure.
chrome_compatibility: Require regular Google Chrome 116 or newer before checking or launching, matching runtime.getContexts and sidePanel.open availability.
installer_signing: Clean extracted macOS metadata, then sign and verify the temporary app before replacing the installed copy.
status_monitor: Read-only native host and dashboard-only adapter verify the running worker SHA directly against GitHub every 15 seconds. No cloud reports or private pairing links. Background updates only while Chrome is closed. Adapter revision 4 isolates each request lifecycle and uses unique worker entry URLs.
